posts.title: Three fringe shows
posts.description: A guest post by Tess reflecting on our day at the Edinburgh Fringe and on comedy, sincerity and niches.

posts.title: Chatting with myself about AI
posts.description: Labubu is an ugly-cute snaggletoothed gremlin and an international phenomenon, but what does she tell us about loneliness, social role-play and simulation, addiction and the hyperreal?

posts.title: Chatting with myself about AI
posts.description: To explore my own experiences and feelings about AI I decided to mimic the chatbot format but with myself on both sides of the screen: a self-interview to explore my reluctance to adopt, my concerns and worries. Perhaps this chat can help me understand my own complex reaction to AI?
